# Vulnerabilities present and accepted for now, one "package GHSA-id" per line.
#
# Each needs a semver range moved — a change with its own risk — or has no
# released fix: tar's is 7.x, a major; multer's is 2.x; lodash's advisory names
# a version that its consumers do not accept. This is a list to shrink, and the
# check names entries that stop appearing so they can be deleted.
#
# Regenerated 2026-08-09 after pinning axios, undici, ws, dompurify, postcss,
# brace-expansion and form-data to single patched versions.
